description: This file contains unit tests for the MainThread class in the Rialto server component, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests creation, registration, task enqueuing, and client unregistration functionalities of MainThread.

classes.name: DummyMock
classes.description: A mock class used to simulate client behavior with a mockMethod.

classes.name: MainThreadTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MainThread functionalities.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWaitOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() and waits for its completion.

methods.name: enqueueTaskOnDummyMock
methods.description: Enqueues a task that calls dummyMock->mockMethod() without waiting.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Enqueues a task to unregister a client and waits for its completion.
